data.body: Fixed: changed Jest TS/TSX invocation in _process_test_result from bare positional arg ('jest $full_test_path') to '--runTestsByPath $full_test_path'. --runTestsByPath (available since jest 24.x) treats each argument as an exact filesystem path, not a regex — bracket segments like [id] and [locale] are no longer misinterpreted as regex character classes. Added regression test file tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-bracket-paths.sh covering 4 cases: source-level assertion, bracket-path pass, bracket-path fail, static-path regression guard. All 9 new assertions pass; existing hook tests unaffected.
